question: Which of the famous personalities belonged to the extremist phase of modern history?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bal Gangadhar Tilak**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bal Gangadhar Tilak** belonged to the extremist phase of modern history.
 
• He was a prominent leader of the Indian independence movement and a strong advocate of Swaraj or self-rule.
 
• Tilak was the founder of the Home Rule League and popularized the slogan "Swaraj is my birthright and I shall have it".
 
• He was also a vocal critic of the British colonial rule and was imprisoned several times for his anti-British activities.
 
• Tilak's contribution to the Indian freedom struggle is widely acknowledged and he is often referred to as the "father of Indian unrest".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **P.M. Mehta** was a prominent Indian lawyer and politician who played an important role in the Indian National Congress. However, he was not associated with the extremist phase of modern history.
 
• **A.O. Hume **was a British civil servant who founded the Indian National Congress in 1885. He was considered a moderate and believed in gradual reforms within the British colonial framework.
 
• Gopal Krishna Gokhale was another prominent Indian nationalist who advocated for constitutional reforms and peaceful negotiations with the British. He was also a mentor to Mahatma Gandhi. However, he was not associated with the extremist phase of modern history.
